name: UDID Card (Unique Disability ID)
benefit: Ek single card for all government benefits and tracking.
eligibility: Any person with a certified disability.
how_to_apply: Apply online at swavlambancard.gov.in with medical certificate.

name: ADIP Scheme (Assistance to Disabled Persons)
benefit: Free assistive devices (wheelchair, hearing aid, braille kits, etc.)
eligibility: Income < Rs. 22,500 per month, valid disability certificate (40%+).
how_to_apply: Nearest ALIMCO center ya district social welfare office.

name: Divyangjan Pension Scheme (National Social Assistance Programme)
benefit: Monthly pension (amount varies by state, usually Rs. 300 to Rs. 3000).
how_to_apply: Apply through District Social Welfare Officer or local panchayat/municipality.

name: Railway/Bus Concession Certificate
benefit: 25% to 75% concession in train fares and free/discounted bus travel in state transport.
eligibility: Valid disability certificate and specific forms certified by a Govt Doctor.
how_to_apply: For railways, get a concession certificate from a Govt Hospital and apply at DRM office.

name: 4% Reservation in Government Jobs
benefit: 4% quota in Group A, B, C, D posts in Central/State Government.
how_to_apply: Apply through normal recruitment channels (UPSC, SSC, State PSC) and claim PwD quota.

name: Deendayal Disabled Rehabilitation Scheme (DDRS)
benefit: Financial assistance to NGOs providing services like special schools, vocational training, half-way homes.
eligibility: Beneficiaries access services through funded NGOs.
how_to_apply: Find local NGOs funded under DDRS in your district.

name: National Fellowship for Students with Disabilities
eligibility: Post-graduate students with disabilities pursuing higher education.
how_to_apply: UGC website portal during application cycles.

name: Accessible India Campaign (Sugamya Bharat Abhiyan) Apps
benefit: Sugamya Bharat App to report inaccessible public spaces and buildings.
eligibility: Any citizen can use it to help PwDs.
how_to_apply: Download Sugamya Bharat App from Play Store/App Store.
